description: NaTa₄Bi₅O₁₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.67 Å. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-29°. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.16 Å. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-29°. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.62 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.64 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.66 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ta, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ta, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Ta and two Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Ta and two Bi atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Ta and one Bi atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Ta atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ta, and one Bi atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, two Ta, and one Bi atom.
